description: Returns live cards from one Lingard vocabulary collection by UUID or title, including curated Lingard collections and the "Words not in a collection" bucket of cards saved while reading. With includeExamples:true it also returns each card's example sentences and their translations, which editing examples starts from.

inputSchema.description: Identify the collection with `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` (provide one; UUID wins if both are given).

collectionTitle.description: Collection selector (alternative to `collectionUuid`): the collection title.

collectionUuid.description: Collection selector (preferred): its UUID. One of `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` is required.

includeExamples.description: Default false. True returns the full example rows (`examples`: example text, translation line, enabled flag) for every card instead of just the `exampleCount`.

limit.description: Optional max number of cards to return (1–1000).

name: lingard_get_vocab_collection

exampleCount.description: Number of examples stored on the card. Request includeExamples:true to read their text.

examples.description: Example rows, returned only when the call asked for includeExamples:true.

c.description: Example sentence in the target language, with the target word wrapped in {}.

e.description: Whether the example is enabled on the card.

t.description: Translation line, or null when the example is deliberately left untranslated.

hasExamples.description: True when the card carries examples with the target word highlighted. Independent of whether they are translated.

title: Get Lingard Vocabulary Collection
